title: 极睿电商生图 MCP 配置
description: 每位用户须登录个人账户，手动创建名为 WorkBuddy 的独立 Token，且不得在其他 MCP 客户端复用。仅专业版或企业版个人账户可调用，任务消耗该用户本人积分。凭证由 WorkBuddy 仅保存在本机。
description_en: Each user must sign in to a personal account and manually create a dedicated token named WorkBuddy without reusing it in any other MCP client. Calls require a Pro or Enterprise personal account and consume that user's credits. WorkBuddy stores the credential locally only.
docLabel: 查看 WorkBuddy Token 获取与配置教程
docLabel_en: View the WorkBuddy token setup guide

fields.label: WorkBuddy Token
fields.placeholder: 登录极睿个人账户 → MCP Token 管理 → 创建 Token → 名称填写 WorkBuddy
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in to Infimind → MCP Token management → Create token → Name it WorkBuddy
fields.description: 仅填写本人账户创建的独立 Token，请勿在其他 MCP 客户端复用。
fields.description_en: Use a dedicated token created by your own account; do not reuse it in another MCP client.
